title: Tiny, cute crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFE866'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cheekGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB6C1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8FAB'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Moon body: crescent shape -->
  <path d='M 55 18 
           A 35 35 0 1 0 72 78
           A 28 28 0 1 1 55 18 Z' 
        fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- Moon highlight edge -->
  <path d='M 58 24 
           A 30 30 0 0 0 68 72
           A 30 30 0 0 1 58 24 Z' 
        fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5.5' fill='#4A4A8A'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5.5' fill='#4A4A8A'/>
  <!-- Left eye shine -->
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye shine -->
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Left cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='url(#cheekGlow)' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- Right cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='url(#cheekGlow)' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 43 54 Q 47.5 60 52 54' 
        stroke='#4A4A8A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tiny star sparkle near moon -->
  <path d='M 75 30 L 76 27 L 77 30 L 80 31 L 77 32 L 76 35 L 75 32 L 72 31 Z' 
        fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Small star -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Another tiny star -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='65' r='1.2' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
